exposure: Ambulance travel time to the hospital
Severity of indications for cesarean section
cohort: 441 neonates born via emergency cesarean section at three rural district hospitals in Rwanda in 2015
finding: Longer ambulance travel time to the hospital, four or more prior pregnancies, and very severe indications for cesarean delivery were associated with poor neonatal outcomes (death within 24 h or APGAR < 7 at 5 min).
